purpose: Launch one admitted Agent embodiment into one exact Carrier Session with one immutable Orientation Manifest generation.

agent_id.rule: Compatibility display key; exact identity authority is the revisioned agent_identity reference inside the admission receipt.

site_root.rule: Scopes Site law and runtime state; it does not import another Site's authority.

carrier_session_id.rule: Must exactly equal the admitted Carrier Session coordinate.

carrier_session_admission_receipt.rule: Owner-issued receipt for this exact Site, Agent identity revision, Carrier Session, authority epoch, Carrier kind, and policy readback.

embodiment_admission.rule: A bounded launch projection with owner_token_exposed=false; it cannot replace or broaden the receipt.

orientation_manifest_id.rule: Names one persisted immutable generation bound to the exact admission receipt; latest-generation lookup is forbidden.

agent_start_event_id.rule: Records materialization after admission; it neither creates nor substitutes for admission.

startup_command.rule: Starts delivery of the exact receipt-bound manifest projected in the Carrier environment. Each response owns the next opaque continuation; the occupant never chooses evidence steps, offsets, or a checkpoint.

optional_after_orientation.rule: Read-only first-work orientation may follow admitted manifest delivery. Explicit task handoffs use narada_task_read; generic discovery uses narada_task_work_next with claim=false.

startup_sequence.rule: The Carrier follows each returned opaque continuation until status=ready and ordinary_work_gate=open. Continuity may enter startup only when an exact continuity projection was already selected and bound into this manifest generation. Diagnostic hydration, direct acknowledgement, and ambient latest checkpoint selection are not occupant startup steps.

startup_first_work_orientation.rule: Read-only work orientation after manifest delivery; it does not claim, activate, publish, deploy, or grant credentials.

required_environment.rule: Environment transports exact admitted bindings into MCP children; matching values do not themselves create authority.

tool_approval_policy.rule: Approves only admitted MCP/tool surfaces, including policy-aware shell MCP when separately allowed, and does not convert availability into action authority.

native_execution_policy.rule: Native shell/script access and policy-aware Narada shell MCP are separate capabilities.

launch_result_path.rule: Durable packet path is authoritative over terminal or TUI copy truncation.

result_sentinel.rule: Copy-safe marker proving the launch result packet ended.

not_claimed.rule: The launch packet states what admission and orientation do not prove.

version_compatibility.rule: New optional fields may be added compatibly; required field or authority-semantic changes require a new contract version.
